summary: The task failed verifier checks (test_legacy_node_checks) despite the agent's confidence. The trace reveals critical gaps: (1) agent used --break-system-packages despite explicit anti-pattern warning, (2) confusion about which column letter to reference in cross-sheet formulas (tried O12, F12, etc.), (3) formulas referencing incorrect cells (=F8 instead of correct Amount column), (4) lack of verification that formulas actually point to populated cells. The reconciliation skill needs stronger guardrails, dynamic column letter calculation, and explicit verification steps.
